headlines.title: 5 Arrested on Suspected Terror Plot at US Air Base in Britain
headlines.description: Five men have been arrested by U.K. police on a suspected terror plot at a key U.S. Air Base in Britain. Now an urgent investigation is underway with officials looking into whether Iran was behind the threat. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: 8 Marines Injured in Previously Unreported Iranian Attack on Hormuz
headlines.description: Three U.S. officials tell NBC News that eight American Marines were injured two weeks ago in a previously unreported Iranian attack in which a cruise missile struck their vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Right-wing conservatives push to shut down the last active Jan. 6 prosecution
headlines.description: They say Brian Cole Jr. was framed. The Justice Department is pressing forward with the case.

headlines.title: White House releases new taxpayer-funded ad describing ‘final battle’
headlines.description: The ad is nearly identical to one Trump’s presidential campaign released in 2024.

headlines.title: Bill Gates says AI 'powerful enough' to cause 'a billion deaths'
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates calls for government safeguards to address the risks posed by artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: The dozen games that turned Week 3 into one of the wildest in NFL history
headlines.description: Two seconds remained in regulation in Denver.

headlines.title: Watch highlights from the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards
headlines.description: Watch highlights from the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, with Queen of Pop Madonna returning to the stage after over two decades and Taylor Swift making history as the first recipient of the Artist Director Honors and winning Video of the Year for “The Fate of Ophelia." Plus heartwarming tributes to Dolly Parton and George Michael.

headlines.title: How an American teacher’s $5,000 donation helped turn a Chinese desert into a lush forest
headlines.description: Ronald Sakolsky couldn’t believe his eyes when he visited China’s Mu Us Desert for the first time in 26 years. “Seeing it with my own eyes, that was the biggest surprise,” he said.

headlines.title: Europe frets as the Kremlin pushes the limits of its hybrid warfare
headlines.description: The Kremlin is testing Europe‘s limits.

headlines.title: Inside NBC News’ polling averages: Democrats enjoy biggest lead yet in the race for Congress
headlines.description: Meanwhile, President Donald Trump’s approval rating is at a low point for his second term.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Andrew Bailey, who joined FBI in unusual ‘co-deputy’ position, to leave bureau
headlines.description: FBI co-deputy director Andrew Bailey, who joined the FBI in the newly created position in September 2025 to work alongside then-Deputy Director Dan Bongino, is stepping down, two people familiar with the matter tell NBC News.
